title: Whisker Blademaster
html:
Whisker Blademaster

Whisker Blademasters are tall Whiskers who wield two swords. They charge into combat usually Stunning or knocking their opponent down.

Race: Whisker

Class: Melee

Basic Types

Name Element Habitat
Whisker Blademaster None Dew Valley Forest, Algernon
Poison Blademaster Poison Algernon
Toxic Blademaster Poison Cavernous Cavern of Caves
Fire Dancer Fire Cavernous Cavern of Caves
Forest Blademaster Poison Widower's Nest
Divine Whisker Blademaster Divine Karnage's Lot, Choppe's Shoppe
Arctic Blademaster Ice Ratsputin's Gulag


Uniques

  • Rattle Tooth a champion who shares Sissirat's Lair.
  • Rattle Tooth's relatives, such as Rattle Eye, Rattle Toe, and even Rattle Tooth's DJ and Rattle Toe's Personal Masseur occupy higher level dungeons. They get progressively stronger as the dungeon level gets higher.
  • Dr. Richard Choppe is a Divine Whisker Blademaster Hero who will be found in Choppe's Shoppe off of Level 7 of Frump's Misfortune.

Behavior

  • Whisker Blademasters have a variety of moves at their disposal, which are:
    • A holy roller-like attack which can knock you down for 2-5 seconds
    • A butcher-like attack which deals vicious damage to low levels
    • And their normal attack, a sweeping blow with their scimitars.
